tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Signal Fire MC-16 Fiber Stripper Multi-Functions with Fiber Cleaver is a practical and versatile tool for fiber optic technicians and network installers. It combines fiber stripping and cleaving functions in a compact design, helping technicians perform essential fiber preparation tasks efficiently.


Designed for use in fiber optic installation, FTTH networks, telecommunications, and splicing applications, the MC-16 provides a convenient solution for preparing optical fiber before fusion splicing or connector installation. Its multifunctional design makes it a useful addition to professional fiber optic toolkits.


Key Features


  • Signal Fire MC-16 multifunctional fiber optic tool
  • Integrated fiber stripper and fiber cleaver
  • Designed for optical fiber preparation
  • Compact and portable design
  • Suitable for FTTH and fiber optic installation
  • Useful for fusion splicing applications
  • Helps prepare fiber for connector termination
  • Suitable for telecommunications and data networks
  • Convenient tool for field technicians
  • Ideal for professional fiber optic maintenance
